d: Southern nautical constellation formerly part of Argo Navis, featuring luminous Canopus and deep-sky treasures.

hip-30438.x: Second brightest star in the night sky (mag -0.74, ~310 ly), widely used as a primary navigational guide for spacecraft.

hip-45238.x: Luminous white subgiant star forming the southern anchor of the Diamond Cross asterism.

ic-2602.x: Radiant southern open star cluster centered on blue subgiant Theta Carinae.

carina-nebula.x: Vast star-forming complex and home of luminous blue variable Eta Carinae.
